evidence.note: Early payoff: "Hitman snaps off missile dropkick — Hall takes 19 damage. / Hall is rattled…" — real setup tension before the slog.
Hall already at 1 HP ([117,1]) after missile dropkick; match still has ~200 turns left. Gate failure: turn_count 248 outside [8,40].
Finish menu offers Cover + Sharpshooter 89% while Hall is GROUNDED at 1 HP; methodical selects Climb (index 3) instead — repeated across 16 pin-offer turns with 0 covers taken.
Mid-match loop t90–102: climb → get_up → missile/elbow → get_up while HP stuck ~[87,1]; same intents with no climax. move_repetition_rate=0.4435; Grapple control streak spans player turns ~147–201.
Comeback window exists (Hall grinds Hitman to 1 HP via grapple counters) but without near-falls (near_fall_count=0), so the swing feels like attrition not drama.
Curated intents readable (Grapple control / Set up position / Safe offense / Reset) with % labels; collar note warns "repeat loops lose steam."
Groggy logged as modifier, not position: "Hall rises — still groggy from the impact!" with state groggy=[false,true] while position STANDING.
When cover is legal, Finish shows Cover — pinfall attempt first (curation_pin_visible=true); Sharpshooter label 89% reads as apply-chance style %, not a hidden win meter.
Stall feedback is explicit: "The repeated tie-up stalls out — Hall gains escape momentum." single_choice_turns=3 (e.g. t247 only Fight to your feet) are honest grounded prompts.
After Hall fails get_up ("vulnerable… Escape momentum builds") the match still refuses to end for another 148 turns — curiosity drains into fatigue.
Late both-at-1HP stretch still spam-collars (55 player collar-elbows total); log_uniqueness_ratio=0.1641 signals a samey rematch.
Only the CPU’s first cover ends it; no player finish experiment was tried despite 16 curated Finish offers — little reason to queue the same methodical loop again.

stickiness.rematch_reason: 248-turn methodical climb/missile/collar grind with zero near-falls and zero player covers makes another full match feel like a chore, not a curiosity pull.
stickiness.next_experiment: Replay seed 103 with aggressive (or a finish-biased policy) that takes Cover/Sharpshooter when Hall is at 1 HP and pin is curated; compare turn_count and near_fall_count vs this methodical refusal loop.
